তারিখ : ২২ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২১ বঙ্গাব্দ/ ০৫ জুন, ২০১৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দ।

Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh, acting through the Ministry of Finance, issued this official notification under its regulatory authority.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance, specifically its Internal Resources Division, is the authority responsible for issuing this customs and value-added tax related notification.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance serves as the administrative body responsible for customs and value-added tax matters addressed in this notification.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government to issue notifications regarding customs duty matters.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(1) of this Act provides the legal authority for the Government to amend tax-related provisions in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Government exercises its authority to amend customs notifications in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
S.R.O. 147-AIN/2013/2434/Customs: This existing notification is amended by this order to include new tariff headings and descriptions for specific commodities.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The table of the specified notification is updated by adding new Heading numbers and corresponding commodity descriptions to the tariff schedule.
Specific entries for Sorghum, Millet, Guar meal, and Zeolite are added to the official customs tariff table.
